ask: this is a mess muse fix it
sentence: A shared store run list where group members add items they want, say "me too" on others' items, and one chosen shopper checks items off as they are picked up.
use_when: Someone is making a store run for the group and people need to say what they want
A messy chat list of requests for one shopping trip needs to become a single checklist
The group wants to see who asked for each item and what is already picked up
One person needs to hand the shopping role to someone else mid-trip
dont_use_when: Splitting costs or tracking who owes whom after a purchase
A recurring grocery or meal plan list that lasts for weeks
Voting between options or picking a place to go
